description.zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在[物联网SIM服务控制台](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID。
description.en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card, or view the ICCID on the Card Management page of the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8).

description.zh:
是否对子卡进行操作，填入子卡的MSISDN。

- 普通单网卡无需传入此参数。
- 虚拟运营商：
    - 如果传入该参数，则对指定的子卡进行操作。
    - 如果不传入该参数，则对所有子卡进行操作。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform the operation on sub-cards by entering the MSISDN of the sub-cards.

- This parameter is not required for regular single network cards.
- For virtual operators:
    - If this parameter is specified, the operation is performed on the specified sub-cards.
    - If this parameter is not specified, the operation is performed on all sub-cards.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明


单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Usage Notes


The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account to call this API operation is 20.

> RAM users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
